title: Prove sharp P112 rank-five shortening at common support 47
body:
## Summary

```diff
- Uniform rank-five P112 shortening: sufficient common cut 46
+ Sharp common cut 47; exact rational counterexample at 48
```

For three arbitrary residual pieces of binary support rank at most five over characteristic zero, their span meets the restricted root code in dimension at most one after ONE common cut of size at most 47. The cut 48 witness includes every rational coefficient and exact support rank.

The new D6 near-equality proof covers eleven-live supports whose twelve-root closure touches the removed frame. It combines with [PR3280's separate A2 incidence 20 lemma](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3280), retained from scientific commit `129eba68a1ae082ea65dffcfd93a1305165113e1`. Credit PR3249/3257/3266/3269, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 and the retained E8/P112 lineage. All source paths, heads and hashes are pinned; no pending Git objects are needed in fresh replay.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3266 stops at46, leaving the29-zero normalization and A2 incidence boundary open.
- After: written proof; 194,310 five-spaces, 240 full-root closures, 240 punctures, a separate 474,672-basis check and an actual cut 48 witness. Seven control groups include altered coefficients/cut, proportional codewords and source-usage/schema mutations.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay, source metadata, Ruff and exact committed read-only Git-free optimized CPython 3.13 replay pass. A designated read-only peer receipt is included in REVIEW.json.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-rank5-sharp47
```

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One new package; selected frontier and frozen predecessors unchanged. This is a scoped shortening theorem with retained capacity/A2 proofs and the standard Weyl/chamber and label-transport premises. No actual caller/profile, full C5, decoder floor, native/physical supplier, consumer or kappa claim. Formal-kernel/human review, Lean, Docker and selected cold replay are unrun. Open next questions require a separately reconciled literal caller.
